summary: Iteration 2: Verified all 4 new features (filters & search, dependencies + lock icon, TIMELINE/Gantt view, move task to another project, file attachments) and full regression (subtasks, timer, calendar, dashboard, kanban status change). 18 prior backend tests pass + 4 new backend tests for reorder/blocked_by/move_project/attachments pass. All targeted frontend flows pass.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from Emergent's visual-editor instrumentation injecting <span> wrappers inside <option> elements (x-ve-dynamic spans). The application source uses correct '<option>{t}</option>' syntax — this is a preview-only dev warning, not a runtime bug. Safe to ignore in production build.

critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetail.jsx: timeline tab passes tasks=[...filteredTop, ...subtasks_of_all_projects_not_filtered], could render subtasks not matching filters. Minor.
TaskDialog moveProject() does not call onReload — onSaved removes the task from current list; works because project_id changed. OK.
Drag-to-reorder not exercised in UI tests (Playwright drag is flaky); covered by direct API test in test_new_features.py::TestReorder.
seed_data_creation: Created project 'PT_Sandbox_2' with 3 tasks (Alpha/Beta/Gamma). Gamma was moved to 'API Gateway Rewrite' to verify move-project flow. Alpha was set blocked_by Beta and marked done; attachment 'test.txt' uploaded to Alpha.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend new endpoints (/api/tasks/reorder, /api/tasks/{id}/attachments, /api/attachments/{id}, /api/files/{id}/download?auth=, PUT /api/tasks/{id} with blocked_by + project_id) are all verified. Frontend ProjectDetail filters (search-input/filter-status/filter-priority/filter-tag/clear-filters), TimelineView (timeline-view/timeline-bar-{id}), TaskDialog deps (dep-check-{id}), attachments (upload-attachment-button/attachment-file-input/attachment-list), move-project-select all work. Console hydration warning is from Emergent visual-editor instrumentation, not real app bug. Drag-reorder UI not exercised via Playwright; reorder API tested directly.
